children: Storm hit your roof? We handle the damage — and the claim.
Ironclad is the storm-damage specialist that documents the hit, works directly with your insurance, and gets you a new roof — while you get on with your life. Start with a free inspection.

children: We climb up, document every hit, and tell you straight whether you have a claim — no charge and no pressure to sign anything.
From the first photo to the final invoice, we speak the adjuster’s language and handle the paperwork so you don’t have to fight it alone.
Water coming in? We roll the same day to tarp and protect, stopping the damage from spreading before the claim is even settled.
A storm rarely hits just the roof. We handle siding, windows and the whole exterior, so it’s one crew and one plan, not three.

children: We handle the claim. You get a new roof.

Filing a storm claim on your own is a part-time job — photos, measurements, the right language, and an adjuster who moves on their own schedule. We do all of it. We document the damage, submit the evidence, and meet the adjuster on your roof so nothing gets missed or lowballed.
You stay in the loop and in control; we carry the weight. When it’s approved, our crews do the work — roof, siding or the whole exterior — and you pay your deductible, not a surprise.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Ironclad Roofing & Exteriors is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: An Ironclad crew and branded truck at a storm-damaged house, ready to tarp and inspect

children: Built for the day after the storm

Ironclad Roofing & Exteriors started after one too many neighbors got steamrolled by their own insurance company — underpaid, under-documented, and left with a patch job instead of the roof they were owed. We decided to be the contractor that stands on the homeowner’s side of the table.

We’re a storm-damage and exteriors specialist: roofing, siding, windows and full exteriors, backed by people who know how claims actually work. We document it right, fight for the full scope, and do the work like it’s our own house.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every hit photographed and measured, so your claim is built on evidence an adjuster can’t wave off.
Roof, siding, gutters and windows handled together — no juggling three contractors after one storm.
Fully licensed and insured crews, manufacturer-backed materials, and a workmanship warranty in writing.
